_about: ASR sound-alike corrections — the TUNING SURFACE. Add a correction here when you witness a mishearing live; re-run the harness to confirm it helps and regresses nothing. This is data, not code: never edit the parser to add a correction. Moved out of the hardcoded MISHEARD_INCIDENTS and REPLACEMENTS in cleaner.py.
_rules: Corrections are SCOPED: 'stage' = which part of the pipeline / field the rule targets.
Corrections are ORDERED: applied top-to-bottom within a stage. Put narrow rules before broad ones so a broad rule doesn't clobber a narrow match.
Each correction is measurable: it's a hypothesis the harness validates.

_stages.pre_extraction: Applied to the full normalized transcript before any field extraction (old REPLACEMENTS).
_stages.channel: Applied to the channel slot before channel matching (sound-alikes for channel tokens).
_stages.incident_type: Applied to the incident_type residual after extraction (old MISHEARD_INCIDENTS).
